headline: Approved school grants including $694,752 preschool partnership; tabled school policy changes until next meeting.
summary: The meeting covered the return to the West school building, a long-range planning process, and multilingual learner results. Members approved a revised school calendar and accepted school grants. They tabled changes to the school policy manual until the next meeting.
decisions: Tabled changes to school policy manual Section B, except BEDH and BEDH-E, until the next November meeting.
Approved a revised school calendar with a noon dismissal at West Somerville Neighborhood School on January 4th, 2027.
Accepted federal and state grants for Somerville Public Schools, including $694,752 for the Commonwealth Preschool Partnership.
discussion: Long-range planning goals: Members discussed how many goals to set, with 3 to 5 suggested, and how to get input from students and families. A questionnaire is due November 16th.

Multilingual learner results: Members asked about English language progress, former English learners, and gaps on state tests. Staff said the district exceeded its state progress targets for non-high school and high school grades.
Return to the West: Members thanked the city, the district, the PTA, and staff for the move back to the West building. Members said only one day of school was lost during the move.
Student activities and X-Block: Student representatives reported on school events and on the change from X-Block to a homeroom block. They said a student survey on the change drew 215 responses.
Next year's school calendar: Members discussed when the draft calendar would come. Staff said the union contract sets much of the calendar, and last year's draft was late.

decision_evidence.quote: So, uh with the Chair's blessing, I I would propose that we table this motion until our next meeting. All right. We consider the motion tabled until our next November meeting.

Chair, I move to approve the revised school year '27 school calendar to include a noon dismissal for WSNS on January 4th, 2027, as a makeup day for the October 13th school closure. ... Seeing none, all those in favor, aye. All opposed? Any abstentions? That motion passes.

I move to accept all federal entitlement and continuation grants, and all state continuation grants awarded to the Somerville Public Schools ... All those in favor, aye. All opposed, any abstentions? The motion passes.
